card.title: Warmly Enforced
card.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though. Can you catch a later train?

mechanism: A warmly hosts a guest while each accommodation reveals a stricter breakfast rule that admits no exception.
confusable: Unlike cold refusal, A must preserve welcoming language while narrowing access to the same need.
comparison: A train-bound guest faces room, time and food-location limits; the swimming applicant faces observation and induction loops.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
